name: Bob Evans Farms - Springfield OH Transportation Hub
type: Distribution / transportation hub (private fleet terminal - Bob Evans Transportation Company LLC, USDOT 911163; ~100 tractor-trailers)

citations.claim: FMCSA: Bob Evans Transportation Company LLC, USDOT 911163, Operating Status ACTIVE, 6088 Green Field Dr, Springfield OH 45502; 144 power units / 118 drivers; MCS-150 updated Feb 2026.
Company main transportation facility in Springfield OH: ~150 employees / 100 drivers, 100+ tractor-trailers, 20,000+ deliveries/yr distributing Bob Evans products.
NLRB rep case for Bob Evans Farms at 6088 Green-Field Dr, Springfield OH; bargaining unit of drivers, dock workers, and yard jockeys (84 employees) - confirms active on-site yard operation.

verification.rationale: FMCSA active carrier (updated Feb 2026), company site, and two NLRB cases (one naming 'yard jockeys') place an active private-fleet terminal at 6088 Green Field Dr; distinct from the closed ~2012 sausage plant.

fieldNotes.imagery: Only available satellite coverage of this site is heavy snow-cover imagery, which obscures fine ground detail (gate hardware, booths, lane markings). No Street View coverage reaches the property. Overall confidence set to medium.
fieldNotes.truckGate: This is a private fleet terminal (Bob Evans Transportation Company, USDOT 911163; ~126 tractors, 100+ tractor-trailers, 20,000 deliveries/yr). The terminal is reached via an internal campus road off Green-Field Dr. A controlled truck entrance is the strong norm for a private fleet hub of this scale, but the gate hardware cannot be positively confirmed in the snow imagery -- flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth could be resolved in the snow imagery. Set false (no booth seen) but flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Given a probable gate and no visible booth, remote check-in is the best inference; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer-parking rows on both sides of the central terminal building; well over 50 trailers -- this is the dominant feature of the site.
fieldNotes.dropYard: The whole site functions as a fleet trailer yard / terminal.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal campus road from Green-Field Dr to the terminal; ample queue depth.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: This is a fleet terminal, not a DC dock building; only a few service/maintenance bays on the central dispatch/shop building (~4). Not a loading-dock operation.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~120 trailers estimated in the parking rows from z17-z19 snow imagery; count approximate.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Marked rows could hold ~160 trailers; estimate.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural -- the terminal sits on the edge of Springfield surrounded by farm fields.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Central dispatch/maintenance building plus an accessory structure; ~2 (the large SW building is part of the wider distribution-center campus and treated as separate from the fleet terminal proper).
